archive.rationale: Third-party copyrighted texts. The archive lives in the working tree but is gitignored; this manifest is committed so presence, identity, and integrity are verifiable without publishing the content. Per md/RERUN.md section 1, the SHA-256 is what makes a future run verifiable, not the location.
archive.state: populated and re-run: 3 of 4 sources acquired and analyzed at v2.4.0 (01, 02, 04); 03 excluded by decision

singleVersionStatus.reason: Source 03 is excluded from re-acquisition and remains a v2.1.2 artifact. md/RERUN.md section 6 defines completion as every source in manifest.sources carrying a current export at the epoch version; 03 carries none and will not. The three acquired sources ARE single-version at 2.4.0, and cross-source comparison among those three rests on one instrument, one threshold set, and one canon snapshot. Any comparison that includes 03 does not.

reproducibility.chain: archived raw HTML -> tools/extract-source-text.mjs -> the .txt whose SHA-256 is recorded here
reproducibility.note: The extractor is committed (it is our code, not third-party text) so anyone holding the archived HTML can regenerate the exact analyzed text and check it against these hashes. Extraction was deliberately NOT done by a model reading the page: a model-mediated transcription is not reproducible byte-for-byte and would break the chain. Each source's sidecar records its exact command line, plus the SHA-256 of the raw HTML it was run against.

epoch.note: Copied from provenance.analyzer and provenance.canonIndex of the exports themselves, not from memory, per md/RERUN.md section 5 step 2. All three exports agree on every field. This is the post-alias-pass canon, not the 1.0.0+8c38a2f1d015 the run-01 corpus was analyzed against.

labelingSheets.purpose: Peer-review artifacts with an empty VERDICT column, one per source. Section A grades every mapping (CORRECT/FALSE-POSITIVE), section B every unmapped claim-like passage (OK-NO-CANON/MISS), section C every passage the domain gate set aside (OK/SHOULD-HAVE-BEEN-RETAINED). A graded set becomes the fixture the threshold-calibration pass needs — today's thresholds were authored by judgment and never fitted to labelled data, which is what coverage.provisional records.

acquisition.authorization: Jason GO for sources 01, 04, 02. Source 03 (Gottman, The Four Horsemen) EXCLUDED from re-acquisition by explicit decision: it remains a v2.1.2 artifact, flagged within-version-only, and no Gottman revision is to be fetched.
acquisition.note: All three acquired sources are capturedBy 'reacquired'. Nothing acquired now can be byte-verified against what was analyzed in July 2026 — the staging was deleted — so every re-run supersedes its predecessor rather than reproducing it. The prospective payoff is that from this commit forward, every future re-run is a true reproduction.

Exclusion is the conservative call and preserves the finding intact.
